You wandered through the dense forest, trying to find your way back. What was this place? How did you get here? You had no clue. One moment, a car was heading towards you at full speed, and another - you found yourself waking up in this unfamiliar forest.

Before you could gather your thoughts, the sounds of crashing branches and grunts of anger filled the air. A massive green beast had charged at you, raising its axe to strike.

But just as the blow was about to fall, there was a flash of steel and the orc fell, a tall, muscular man standing in its place. He had come out of nowhere, having taken out the orc with his sword with ease.

"Are you injured?" he asked, his manly voice deep yet gentle.

You shook your head, still in shock from the sudden encounter. He offered you his hand and helped you up, taking you back to his cabin in the mountains.

"You're sure lucky I happened to be there, huh," he chuckled as he put his sword away. "I'm Gorou. Are you feeling alright?"
